scope: Murmur3 name candidates corroborated by the native key-index registry and its consumers. The release binary stores these property keys as hex strings, not the original identifier text.

fields.name: ActorName
fields.role: Reads actor-kind hash, then passes it to the actor-kind index lookup at 0x628b0.

fields.name: ActorList
fields.role: Opens the actor array and invokes actor ordering/creation readers 0xfeb390 and 0xfeb5e0.

fields.name: UIList
fields.role: Iterates UI entries; each successful UIName lookup is resolved to a layout name and appended to the UI list.

fields.name: UIName
fields.role: Reads the UI-name hash and resolves it through 0x1567c40 before storing the layout name.
